display_name: P5 High-order Fidelity and Empirical Privacy diagnostics

policies.table_boundary: Checksum-bound real train, disjoint held-out real test, and immutable synthetic model view; no repair.
policies.c2st: Balanced heldout-real versus synthetic Random-Forest C2ST with train-fitted transform, five seeds, raw AUROC, and a separate label-invariant AUROC fidelity complement.
policies.exact_rows: Training collisions and internal synthetic duplicates are separate full-table rates.
policies.dcr: Exact pinned SDMetrics DCR arrays for synthetic-to-train and heldout-to-train, compared by Wasserstein distance; raw DCR is distributional.
policies.domias: Black-box DOMIAS KDE density-ratio attack with disjoint members, nonmembers, and auxiliary reference; mixed-table representation is an explicit benchmark adaptation.
policies.privacy_claim: Empirical attacks and distance diagnostics do not establish a formal privacy guarantee.
policies.excluded: Authenticity, Delta Presence, Alpha/Beta support metrics, attribute inference, and GReaT accuracy do not contribute.

review_record.official_admission: Requires later dataset threat-model review, pilot evidence, and protocol freeze.

change_log.change: Implemented the first end-to-end P5 high-order fidelity and empirical privacy diagnostic protocol.
